meta.requirement: Explore Wolvendom (20%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Lupical Trail
start.text:
''The undergrowth thins near a cold stream. Wolf tracks overlap in the mud, fresh enough that the edges have not dried. Something else has been here too: a slick, mineral smell that does not belong in forest water.''

''A boy with wild white hair crouches on a fallen log, one hand pressed to the bank. His grey eyes track movement in the reeds without blinking.''

Razor: ''low, clipped'' You. Travel slow. Good.

''He rises in one motion and points downstream, where the water turns faintly cloudy.''

Razor: Slimes. Blue ones. In the water. Lupical smell wrong water. Pack is angry. ''pause'' Master in the wind sleeps. Water should not wake him.

What_can_I_do.text:
Razor: ''nods once'' Slimes came from the lake first. Starfell Lake. Water runs down, brings more of them.

''He pulls a scrap of leather from his belt and scratches three marks into it with a claw.''

Razor: Go to the lake. Kill the blue ones at the shore. Then I tell you next step.

''He folds the leather and tucks it away.''

Razor: Lupical waits. Do not take long.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Clear the Hydro Slimes from Starfell Lake before they reach Wolvendom

continues.label: Go to Starfell Lake (Mondstadt), do /rpg and then click on Fight the Hydro Slimes. Defeat 2 [[Hydro Slime]]s

whps_ur_master.text:
Razor: ''still watching the stream'' Wolf of the North. Old. Strong. Sleeps in the clearing beyond the trees.

''He taps the muddy bank.''

Razor: Slimes poison the streams that feed his rest. Lupical cannot hunt near bad water. I track upstream. You can help.

''He looks at you properly for the first time. Not hostile. Measuring.''

Razor: Kill slimes. Bring clean things. Then maybe Master will see you.

kill_slime_2x.text:
''The shore goes still. The stream runs clearer already, though not clean enough yet.''

''Razor steps out from the treeline as if he had been there the whole time. He kneels, sniffs the water, and grunts.''

Razor: Better. Not done.

''He produces a second scrap of leather and presses it into your hand. A rough drawing of berries and a bird.''

Razor: Springvale. Hunters there. Leave offering for the rite. Ten Wolfhook. Five Fowl. They know my mark.

''He points back toward the road.''

Razor: When offering is placed, slimes in the woods will move. Be ready.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver Razor's offering to Springvale (10 Wolfhook, 5 Fowl)

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and then click on Place Razor's Offering

10_wolfhook.text:
''Near the village smokehouse, a rack of game hangs under a canvas awning. A broad-shouldered hunter looks up as you approach, then at the leather scrap in your hand.''

Draff: Razor's mark. ''takes the scrap, reads the scratches'' He still does not come into town himself.

''He gestures to a wooden post beside the smokehouse, already hung with dried herbs.''

Draff: Wolfhook and fowl go on the offering post. Whole bundles. Razor's rite needs proper weight, or the woods do not listen.

choices.label: I still need to gather the materials

still_gather.text:
Draff: ''shrugs'' Take your time. The post is here when you are ready.

''He turns back to his game rack.''

Draff: And tell Razor the north stream still runs wrong. He will know what that means.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver Razor's offering to Springvale (10 Wolfhook, 5 Fowl)

offerings.text:
''You tie the Wolfhook bundles and fowl to the post. Draff watches without comment until the last knot is secure.''

Draff: ''nods'' That will hold. The woods know someone paid respect.

''He taps the leather scrap and hands it back.''

Draff: Razor said the slimes would run through Whispering Woods once the offering was set. They always flee toward old water when the rite begins. You will find them on the path to Windrise.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Drive the Hydro Slimes out of Whispering Woods

continues.label: Go to Whispering Woods (Mondstadt), do /rpg and then click on Fight the Hydro Slimes. Defeat 3 [[Hydro Slime]]s

kill_slime_3x.text:
''The last slime dissolves into the loam. The spring clears in slow ripples.''

''Razor drops from a low branch without a sound. He crouches by the water, then straightens.''

Razor: Woods are clean. One step left.

''He holds out a hollow wolf bone, stoppered with wax.''

Razor: Fill this with Slime Condensate. Ten. From the ones you killed. Bring to the North Wind clearing in Wolvendom. I finish the rite there.

''He is already turning back toward the deeper forest.''

Razor: Master sleeps still. Rite must be done before he wakes wrong.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 10 Slime Condensate to Razor at Wolvendom for the cleansing rite

continues.label: Go to Wolvendom (Mondstadt), do /rpg and then click on Bring Razor the Slime Condensate

10_conden.text:
''The North Wind clearing opens ahead, grass bent permanently leeward. Frost lingers in the hollows even when the sun is high. Razor waits at the edge, the wolf bone in his hands.''

Razor: ''without preamble'' Condensate. Ten. For the rite.

still_gather_again.text: Razor: ''nods'' Hunt more slimes. ''taps the bone'' Bring ten. Then rite is done.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 10 Slime Condensate to Razor at Wolvendom for the cleansing rite

give_slime.text:
''Razor uncorks the bone and pours the condensate into a ring of flat stones. It smokes once, then sinks into the ground without a trace. The grass shivers. Far off, a wolf howls, and others answer.''

Razor: ''quiet'' Streams are clean. Lupical can drink. Master can sleep.

''He looks toward the heart of the clearing, where the air bends and the wind has a different weight.''

Razor: You fought for the pack. You brought what was needed. ''pause'' Master may see you now. If you are strong enough.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Meet Razor at the North Wind clearing in Wolvendom

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Enter the North Wind Clearing

North_winds_trust.title: North Wind's Trust
North_winds_trust.text:
''The clearing is still. Razor stands at the tree line, no longer blocking the path inward.''

Razor: North Wind is ahead. Andrius. Wolf of the North.

''He does not follow.''

Razor: I do not fight Master. But you can try. ''looks at you'' Lupical remembers what you did for the water.

''The wind rises once, then settles. The way forward is open.''
